record.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:27 — The new `embeddable_host` setting is matched exactly against the referer host, so an embedding site served on both www/non-www or a non-default port is rejected and the setting takes only a single host.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, embedding is allowed only when `URI(request.referer || '').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, which is an exact host match and therefore will reject a different subdomain such as `www.example.com` vs `example.com` unless the setting is changed. However, the finding’s mention of “non-default port” is not supported by the diff because `URI(...).host` ignores the port (it would still be `example.com`). This is a real limitation/edge-case of the new setting, but not necessarily a defect given the setting is explicitly a single “Host that can embed…”.
